research.facts:
LSU Signs Nation's No. 1 Signing Class
**Source 1:** lsusports.net official release (Nov 11, 2026) — "softball signs top ranked 2027 signing class"
- Class ranked No. 1 nationally by Softball America/Rivals
- First time in LSU softball program history to hold No. 1 class ranking
- Second consecutive top-three class for Beth Torina
- Six signees: Sydney Gonglik (5-star utility/pitcher), Bryli Seifert (4-star infielder, No. 32 overall), Jewel Cooper (4-star catcher, No. 29 overall), Macie Bryant (4-star pitcher, No. 22 overall), Lillie Gaudio (4-star utility), Jillian Wimmer (4-star infielder, No. 39 overall)
- Confidence: HIGH (direct from official university release)
**Source 2:** On3 Softball — "LSU adds four-star pitcher Macie Bryant to stacked 2027 class"
- Bryant: 4-star pitcher, No. 22 overall in Softball America 2027 Rankings, No. 5 in state of Texas, No. 9 at her position
- Confidence: HIGH
**Source 3:** On3 Softball — "Four-star catcher Jewel Cooper joins 2027 LSU recruiting class"
- Cooper: 4-star catcher, No. 29 overall
- Confidence: HIGH
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- LSU class: No. 1 Softball America/Rivals
- Six signees total
- Two five-star athletes (Gonglik)
- Signing date: November 11, 2026
- "First time in program history" per official release

stories.title: 5-for-5 and the House Settlement — College Softball's Double Roster Squeeze

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Two rules are squeezing college softball rosters simultaneously:

House settlement: 25-player cap.
5-for-5: more eligible players than ever.

Programs can roster 5-for-5 athletes — but they can't practice or play.

200+ court cases. No resolution before December. #CollegeSoftball
